display_name: Bus Simulation VR - Bus Driving Game
display_long_description:
Welcome to Bus Simulation VR - Bus Driving Game, the ultimate virtual reality bus driving experience!

Step into the role of a professional bus driver and navigate busy city streets, modern highways, and realistic urban environments. Transport passengers safely to their destinations, manage bus stops, obey traffic laws, and master challenging driving routes.

Experience immersive VR gameplay with detailed bus interiors, realistic vehicle physics, smooth controls, and dynamic city traffic. Whether you're cruising through downtown streets or handling tight turns and busy intersections, every journey feels authentic and engaging.

Features
🚌 Realistic bus driving simulation in VR
🌆 Detailed city environments and roads
👥 Passenger pick-up and drop-off system
🚦 Traffic lights, road signs, and AI traffic
🎮 Smooth and intuitive VR controls
🚏 Multiple routes and bus stops
🌤️ Dynamic environments and immersive visuals
🏆 Complete missions and improve your driving skills
🔊 Realistic bus sounds and driving effects

Take the wheel, follow your route, and become the city's most reliable bus driver in Bus Simulation VR - Bus Driving Game!
